quote: By performing internal computation with hidden states from previous steps, latent reasoning benefit from more informative features rather than sampling a discrete chain-of-thought (CoT) path.
claim: Latent reasoning offers an alternative to autoregressive reasoning by performing internal computation with hidden states, benefiting from more informative features than discrete CoT paths.

quote: Models fail to compose two synthetic facts, but can succeed when one fact is synthetic and the other is natural
claim: Models demonstrate latent two-hop reasoning capability when one fact is synthetic and another is natural, though they fail to compose two purely synthetic facts.

quote: condenses lengthy CoTs into a small set of abstract thinking tokens, preserving essential reasoning while removing redundancy
claim: Heima framework condenses Chain-of-Thought into abstract thinking tokens while preserving essential reasoning through information-theoretic compression.

quote: activates and leverages latent reasoning capabilities in small models through self-training on filtered, self-generated reasoning paths under zero-shot conditions
claim: Self-Enhanced Reasoning Training activates latent reasoning in small models through self-training on filtered, self-generated reasoning paths under zero-shot conditions.

quote: integrates prior hidden states into sampled tokens with a learnable gating mechanism
claim: A hybrid reinforcement learning approach (HRPO) integrates prior hidden states into sampled tokens with a learnable gating mechanism, maintaining LLM generative capabilities while incentivizing hybrid reasoning.

quote: dynamically compresses reasoning processes in latent space through a two-stage training approach
claim: CoLaR framework dynamically compresses reasoning processes in latent space through supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning to reduce reasoning chain length by 53.3%.

quote: autoregressively predicting continuous embeddings of next sentences
claim: Continuous embedding prediction enables abstract reasoning over sentences rather than tokens, reducing inference-time FLOPs by half while maintaining competitive performance.

quote: continuous thought can encode multiple alternative next reasoning steps, allowing the model to perform a breadth-first search (BFS)
claim: Latent reasoning through continuous thought enables breadth-first search capabilities, outperforming discrete CoT on logical reasoning tasks requiring substantial planning search.

quote: reasoning rules can be disentangled within the encoder's parametric space
claim: Language VAEs enable disentangled reasoning rules within encoder parametric space, with FFN layers better preserving rule separation than attention layers.

quote: refines latent reasoning trajectories using two novel strategies
claim: Contrastive reasoning feedback and residual embedding refinement strategies enable effective post-training refinement of latent reasoning trajectories with +5% accuracy gain.

quote: FFN layers are better than attention layers at preserving the separation of reasoning rules in the model's parameters.
claim: Language VAEs enable disentangled reasoning rules within encoder parametric space, with FFN layers better preserving rule separation than attention layers.

quote: adaptive reasoning framework that dynamically allocates computation across reasoning steps through shortcut paths in latent space
claim: System-1.5 Reasoning uses adaptive shortcut paths in latent space to accelerate inference by over 20x while maintaining comparable performance to traditional CoT methods.
